name: x2611_15210_thm1_4
original:
Let $n=Km$ , where $K=2^{a}$ with $a\geq 1$ and $m\geq 3$ is odd, and let $0<p<1$ .
Then $Z>16$ . If $r=4t+d\geq 1$ with $t\geq 0$ and $0\leq d\leq 3$ , then

(1.4)

 $\mathsf{s}(C_{n}^{r})\ \geq\ \frac{n}{4e}\,2^{d}Z^{t}+1.$ 

In particular, with $B_{n,p}=Z^{1/4}>2$ ,

 $\mathsf{s}(C_{n}^{r})\ \geq\ \frac{n}{4e}\Bigl(\frac{2}{B_{n,p}}\Bigr)^{3}B_{n,p}^{r}+1\qquad\text{for every }r\geq 1.$

    positivity
  have hsum : ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f j = 1 := by
    have h := add_pow p (1 - p) n
    have heq : p + (1 - p) = 1 := by ring
    rw [heq, one_pow] at h
    rw [h]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    dsimp [f]
    ring
  let s := (Finset.range (K + 1)).image (fun j => j * m)
  have hsub : s ⊆ Finset.range (n + 1) := by
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj

    simp only [Finset.mem_range]
    omega

    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    · rfl
    · intro j hj k hk heq

  have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by nlinarith
  have h1 : 1 ∉ s := by
    intro hh
    obtain ⟨j, hj, heq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hh

    simp_all
